chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Hammad, from 'Umar ibn Udhaynah and Hariz, from Zurarah, from one of the two (Imams) عليه السلام, who said:
Nothing invalidates wudu (ablution) except what comes out from your two passages, or sleep.

key_terms.النَّوْمُ: sleep, which nullifies wudu in this ruling
key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification required for acts of worship
key_terms.طَرَفَيْكَ: the two bodily passages from which excretions emerge
key_terms.يَنْقُضُ: invalidates or breaks the state of ritual purity

ai.seo_question: What things invalidate wudu (ablution) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on what nullifies wudu (ablution). It states that wudu is invalidated only by excretion from the two bodily passages or by sleep, making it a foundational text in ritual purity rulings.
